QUOTE: index_scope with usable roots? → DerivedScope(source=clew-declaration) ... index_scope present but rejected → log WARNING, fall to whole-repo, reason says why ... nothing declared → whole_repo_scope
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says a declared scope is preferred, but it also says a present-but-broken `index_scope` is refused (cli.py:815) and that excludes-only or no-existing-roots declarations are "rejected rather than quietly widening to the whole repo." That contradicts "every failure to find one falls through to indexing the whole repository."
